title: Parking Location and Curb Cuts Accessing Driveways
previewText: For the purposes of this Section, a private road shall be considered to be a street, and the applicable parking location and curb cut provisions of Section 25-62, inclusive, and Section 25-63, inclusive, shall be applied accordingly.
